test_title: SSC CGL Tier 2 English Previous Paper 1 (Held on: 8 Aug 2022)
subject: english
question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in active voice.**

Has Rahul been declared fit to play the next match?

options.text: Did they declare Rahul fit to play the next match?
Has Rahul declared the next match fit to play?
Have they declared Rahul fit to play the next match?
Are they declaring Rahul fit to play the next match?

solution:
The correct answer is **'Have they declared Rahul fit to play the next match?'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The given sentence is an example of the **passive** voice of the present perfect tense.
 
• Present perfect tense: The present perfect tense is an English verb tense used for past actions that are related to or continue into the present.
 
• Structure:
 
 
• (Active voice) has/have + Subject + the third form of verb+ object
 
• (Passive voice) has/have + Object + been+ the third form of verb + Subject.
 
 
 
• Example:
 
 
• I have written a letter. (Active voice)
 
 
• Here, the subject is 'I', the object is 'letter' and the main verb is 'written' which is the third form of the verb 'write'. To convert this sentence into passive voice, the subject and object will change their places and will be connected with a linking verb followed by the third form of the main verb.
 
 
 
• A letter has been written by her. (Passive voice)
 
 
 
• Since the subject is not given in the sentence, we will look at the options.
 
• Thus, in the above-given sentence, the object of the sentence i.e. **'Rahul' **will exchange its place with the subject of the sentence i.e. **'they', **and will be connected with the linking verb and the third form of the main verb. Since the sentence is given in interrogative structure passive sentence of the given sentence will be converted as follows:
 
 
• Example:
 
 
• Has the paper been torn by you? (Passive voice)
 
• Have you torn the paper? (Active voice)
 
 
 
 
 
• Thus, the correct answer is **option 3.**

 

Correct sentence:__ *Have they declared Rahul fit to play the next match?*
